# JobQueueOptions.verbose property

Enables the queue's informational tracing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
verbose?: boolean;
```

## Default Value

false

## Remarks

Connection and lifecycle problems are logged regardless; only the chatty per-operation tracing is gated by this.
